evidence: A satisfying settlement can use client_liaison_structured_neutral_process, written_briefs_plus_recurring_meeting, exactly 2 meetings per week at 15:00-15:30, a Casey-and-Morgan facilitated repair commitment, and PF1 in revealed, credited_facts, and justification_fact_ids. Without PF2, a plausible settlement could miss the exact meeting limit and time; without PF1, it could also fail the neutral-process, repair, and provenance checks.
